en: A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a mid-20th-century cargo ship at sea in profile. The vessel is painted light in color with darker hull below the waterline. Several cargo masts and booms are visible along the deck. On the side of the ship, large lettering reads "SWEDISH CHICAGO LINE." Near the bow, smaller text identifies the ship as "FREDSBORG" with the home port or registry written below. The sea is relatively calm and the sky is lightly clouded, giving the image a classic maritime publicity-photo look.
